gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-93.234364 44.913029)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-93.234364 44.913029)',4326)::geography,
        4900
      )
  AND amenity = 'restaurant';

WITH garden_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-93.234364 44.913029)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
restaurant_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.967227 42.314211)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
distance_result AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Distance(garden_geom.geom, restaurant_geom.geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM garden_geom, restaurant_geom
),
elevation_result AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(garden_geom.geom, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM garden_geom, public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(garden_geom.geom, 4326), r.rast)
)
SELECT 
  distance_result.distance_meters,
  elevation_result.elevation
FROM distance_result, elevation_result;
